item.title: Ibaraki Girls' Trip: Flower Fields, Pottery & Pacific Seafood
item.description: Ibaraki may not be the first destination that comes to mind for a Japanese girls' trip, but it delivers three things that make for an exceptional group itinerary: photogenic flower landscapes, hands-on creative experiences, and fresh Pacific seafood you will not find at the same quality anywhere closer to Tokyo. The prefecture sits 90 minutes north of Ueno on the Joban Line, and a well-planned three days here combines the best of nature photography, craft culture, and coastal dining without the crowds of Kyoto or Hakone.
